results.title: BAAC chief faces backlash from staff
results.description: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas is set to convene an urgent board meeting over employee protests demanding the resignation of Chatchai Sirilai, president of the Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives (BAAC).

results.title: Supervisors show support for legislation calling for partition of California into two states
results.description: The Kern County Board of Supervisors is drafting a letter in support of Assembly Joint Resolution 23, a bill expressing the intent of the California State Legislature to split the state into two states — coastal and inland.

results.title: Delta mayoral candidate Kruger signs Metro Vancouver Accountability Charter
results.description: Signatories commit to 5 actions aimed at strengthening accountability, transparency and governance

results.title: Nebraska Ed Board approves new North Omaha school in delayed vote
results.description: The Nebraska State Board of Education has voted to approve a Black-founded school in North Omaha after concerns over references of an "abolitionist framework" delayed the process.
